description: 1965 is the Year of the Wood Snake in the Chinese zodiac, from February 2, 1965 to January 20, 1966. Personality, Lunar New Year dates and numerology.
answer: In Chinese astrology, 1965 is the Year of the Wood Snake, a Yin year. It began at Lunar New Year on February 2, 1965 and ended on January 20, 1966, so people born in 1965 before Feb 2 belong to the Wood Dragon year.

sections.heading: When the 1965 Wood Snake year starts and ends
paragraphs: The 1965 Wood Snake year began at Lunar New Year on February 2, 1965 and lasted until January 20, 1966, the day before the next new year. Anyone born between January 1 and Feb 2 1965 therefore belongs to the Wood Dragon year that started in 1964, while someone born in early 1966, up to Jan 20, is still a Wood Snake. The Chinese calendar is lunisolar, which is why the start date moves between January 21 and February 20 instead of staying on January 1. The same Wood Snake combination also falls in 2025, sixty years apart, because five elements and twelve animals realign only once in each sixty-year cycle. Lunar New Year 1965 fell on a Tuesday, while the Western Sun was in Aquarius.

sections.heading: Wood Snake personality
paragraphs: Wise, artistic and thoughtful, the Wood Snake plans for the long term and appreciates beauty and learning. Wood feeds the Snake's Fire, which tradition reads as warmth drawing out a naturally reserved sign. People born now are often more sociable than other Snakes. Attachment to comfort and possessions is the usual caution; letting go frees their energy. Their judgement tends to be quietly excellent.

Wood is the element of spring and of things that grow, so a Wood year is traditionally said to lend any animal a generous, expansive streak. Classical descriptions link it with kindness, idealism and a talent for cooperation: Wood people are often pictured as the ones who start community projects, mentor younger colleagues and believe that most situations can improve with patience and goodwill. The element also carries a strong sense of fairness and a dislike of waste. Its shadow side, according to most readings, is overextension. Like a plant reaching in every direction, a Wood-year person may take on too much, trust too readily or struggle to say no when a cause seems worthwhile.

sections.heading: 1965 in numerology and the twelve-year cycle
paragraphs: In numerology the digits of this year reduce to 3, associated with expression, creativity and sociability, so a 3 year is described as lively and communicative. The digits of 1965 add up to 21, which reduces to 3. In the twelve-year cycle the Snake is the sixth animal, earthly branch Si, with Fire as its fixed element and Yin polarity. The year element is Wood, and in the five-element cycles wood generates Fire. The year before was the Wood Dragon and the year after is the Fire Horse.

In the traditional sexagenary count the year is called Yi-Si: Yi is the Wood heavenly stem and Si is the Snake's earthly branch. Stems and branches alternate between yang and yin together, which is why yin stems only ever meet yin animals.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac is 1965?
faq.answer: 1965 is the Year of the Wood Snake. It started on February 2, 1965 and ended on January 20, 1966.

faq.question: What if I was born in January or February 1965?
faq.answer: Check the date against Feb 2. Born before February 2, 1965, you are a Wood Dragon; born on or after it, you are a Wood Snake.

faq.question: What element is 1965 in the Chinese zodiac?
faq.answer: Wood, a Yin year. The Snake's own fixed element is Fire; the year element changes every two years, while the fixed element stays with the animal.

faq.question: What is the traditional Chinese name for 1965?
faq.answer: Yi-Si. The first part is the heavenly stem, which carries the year's element and polarity; the second is the earthly branch, which carries the animal. Almanacs, calendars and Four Pillars charts identify years this way rather than by animal alone.

faq.question: When is the next Wood Snake year?
faq.answer: 2025, sixty years later, when the five elements and twelve animals line up again; the table also has 2025.
